front.title: Framework for High-Dimensional Anomaly Detection of Network Data in Human-Cyber-Physical Systems

author.organization: School of Computer Science and Technology, XUPT
School of Computer Science and Technology, XUPT

abstract.t:
Human-cyber-physical systems combine human activity, computing and communication services, and networked physical processes. Their network data is heterogeneous and high-dimensional. An abnormal condition can appear in the attributes of one entity, in an interaction between entities, or only when evidence from several domains is considered together.
This document specifies an initial framework for anomaly detection in human-cyber-physical environments. It describes the functions used to inventory observations, construct entity and relation context, analyze high-dimensional data, and report an anomaly result. It also defines a small conceptual information model so that anomaly results retain their observation scope, feature context, and score meaning.
